entities.name: Giuseppe Schirò
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Giuseppe Schirò was an Italian neo-classical poet, linguist, publicist and folklorist of Arbëresh descent. His literary work marked the transition from the Arbëresh language to modern Albanian literature in Italy. He was a major protagonist of the Rilindja, the Albanian cultural awakening or Albanian Renaissance, in Italy.
